caption.text:
60 SQL queries to crack any data interview 🧠

Sixty graded drills on PostgreSQL 16, all running on one small employees / departments / orders dataset. Every task comes with its solution and the exact result it returns on the sample rows, so you can check your own answer line by line.

What's inside, in order:

• The sample schema and data
• Basics: SELECT, DISTINCT, ORDER BY, LIMIT
• Filtering: WHERE, AND/OR, IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, NULL
• Expressions: CASE, COALESCE, strings, dates
• Aggregates: GROUP BY and HAVING
• Joins: INNER, LEFT, anti-join, self-join
• Subqueries: scalar, IN, EXISTS, correlated
• Window functions: ranking, running totals, LAG
• CTEs: WITH, chained and recursive
• Interview scenarios: Nth highest, duplicates, trends
• A one-page SQL drills cheatsheet

Try each query before you flip to the answer. Save this for your next prep session and send it to the friend who is grinding for a data role.

Comment “sql” to get every query and answer as a PDF.
